Class HistoData

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.splot.pdata.HistoData
public class HistoData extends Object
Container for 1D histogram data.

Bin edges are stored in grid[] of length (numBins + 1). Counts are stored in counts[] of length numBins.

Responsibilities

This class is responsible only for data storage and bin arithmetic:

  • Filling, clearing, and querying bin counts
  • Underflow and overflow tracking
  • Basic statistics (mean, sigma, rms)
  • Display preferences (rms vs sigma in legend, stat error flag)

Out-of-scope (separated into dedicated classes)

  • Peak finding and fit-vector preparation — see HistoFitPrep
  • Screen polygon and status-string rendering — see HistoDrawingUtils
Author:
heddle

  • Constructor Details

    • HistoData

      public HistoData(String name, double valMin, double valMax, int numBins)
      Creates a uniform-bin histogram.
      Parameters:
      name - histogram name (used as curve label)
      valMin - range minimum (must be strictly less than valMax)
      valMax - range maximum
      numBins - number of bins (>= 1)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if numBins < 1 or valMax <= valMin

    • HistoData

      public HistoData(String name, double[] grid)
      Creates a histogram with arbitrary (non-uniform) bin spacing.
      Parameters:
      name - histogram name (used as curve label)
      grid - bin-edge array in strictly ascending order (length >= 2)
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if grid is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if grid.length < 2 or the array is not strictly ascending

    • prepareForFitAroundBestPeakGuarded

      public HistoFitPrep.FitWindowData prepareForFitAroundBestPeakGuarded(boolean includeZeroBins, int halfWindowBins, int smoothRadius, boolean ignoreZeroBins, boolean poissonWeights, int minPoints)
      Convenience delegation: finds the best peak using smoothing and robust plateau handling, then prepares fit vectors in a guarded window around it.
      Parameters:
      includeZeroBins - if true, include zero-count bins in fit vectors
      halfWindowBins - requested half-window size (>= 0)
      smoothRadius - smoothing radius for peak detection (>= 0)
      ignoreZeroBins - if true, zero-count bins are skipped as peak candidates
      poissonWeights - if true, include Poisson weights
      minPoints - minimum points required after filtering (>= 1)
      Returns:
      fit window data including metadata about the window that was used
      See Also:
      • HistoFitPrep.prepareForFitAroundBestPeakGuarded(HistoData, boolean, int, int, boolean, boolean, int)
